reviews.author: Tzo B
reviews.text: Vehicle was towed ~20 miles through my insurance. They were quickly out to my relatively remote location. The tow truck driver was quick and efficient in getting my car loaded up. He was professional and friendly the entirety on the 20-25 minute ride. It's also refreshing to speak to individuals owning and/or working for local businesses, rather than corporations. All told, i'd definitely use Certified Towing & Recovery again, if necessary (I'm blessed to not need tows very often, so far, at least.)

reviews.author: Antonio Monserrate
reviews.text: Outstanding Service from Certified Towing! As a business owner, I know the value of reliable service, and Certified Towing has exceeded my expectations every time. From the moment I called, their team was professional, courteous, and fast. They arrived promptly, handled my vehicle with care, and made a stressful situation much easier. What sets them apart is their commitment to customer satisfaction. They don’t just tow your car, they make sure you’re taken care of. Whether it’s a simple tow or a more complex roadside issue, I trust them completely. Tristen is the man, very knowledgeable, friendly, and always goes the extra mile. If you need a towing company that’s dependable, honest, and puts customers first, look no further than Certified Towing. I highly recommend them to anyone in need of top-notch towing and roadside assistance! Thanks again!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Paulukonis
reviews.text: Tristin picked up me and my car with a blown tire as part of an insurance request. There was some confusion with my insurance company, and they did not relay that a tire change was needed. Despite this, he went above and beyond to change my tire for me as a courtesy with his own equipment. He was so kind and changed the tire extremely fast; he even helped me inflate the tire so I could get safely back to my house. It was a very hot day and he took time out of his morning to help me. Definitely recommend him and his company!

reviews.author: Tiffany Black
reviews.text: The absolute BEST towing service I have ever used. As soon as I call, the truck is on the way. Never had to wait more than 15 minutes for a tow truck to show up. They have really helped my family. Friendly and courteous staff! 11 out of 10

reviews.author: David Bridges
reviews.text: Needed a tow on Christmas Eve. The driver was there within 45 minutes and was very polite with me and my kids. You really can't ask for more during the holidays.

reviews.author: Nate Edge
reviews.text: Tristen came out when my wife’s Suburban broke down. He was extremely fast to get to us, had very reasonable pricing, and dropped our vehicle off at the dealership for repairs in a timely manner! 10/10 recommend!!

reviews.author: Justin Smith
reviews.text: They were Awesome, on time then I forgot my keys and he stayed an waited. I would recommend them every time 100%. Thank you for all the help. If ya need a tow, definitely call them.

reviews.author: Austin
reviews.text: Outstanding support. Tristen got to me on the side of the road within 20min. Got me home safe. He’s a very genuine person that helped me in my time of need. Give him a call!!!!

reviews.author: Andrew Babos
reviews.text: Tristan really helped me and my family. His communication was top notch and delivered on time. 100% highly recommend this business.
